files.summary: distinguish current cooperative strike denial from unimplemented PvP consent and death policy
edits: It supports both people and animals as targets, subject to current participation and permission checks. Cooperative admission refuses strikes from one human-controlled character against another; approach or wind-up also stops if changed control makes the current attacker/target pair forbidden, or the target stops participating. Recovery after an already committed impact remains separate. This is an interim denial, not an implemented consent mode: [BW14](maintainers/base-world.md#accepted-lifecycle-and-protection-delivery) still owns explicit PvP participation and consequential-death behavior. No weapon is required; equipping a weapon does not modify a punch.
